lgpd.hint: Data governance (LGPD): processing purposes, consents and the external-AI rule.

classes.title: Data classes and external AI
classes.rule: secret, pii and restricted_ai NEVER leave to external LLMs. financial and legal only with a registered purpose carrying an explicit exception. public, internal and client pass the gate normally. Every AI adapter must validate via src/server/ai/policy.ts.

purposes.title: Processing purposes
purposes.externalAi: Allow external AI for these classes (explicit exception)

consents.title: Consents
consents.subjectHint: Never use a real name/e-mail here — PII stays out of this table.
consents.needPurpose: Register a purpose before recording consents.
